indexes.//: Admin queue: pending listings, oldest first. Firestore needs a composite index whenever a query filters on one field and orders by another.
Browse: live listings, newest first. Same two fields, opposite direction, and Firestore treats that as a separate index. Not used yet; Bismah's browse needs it the moment it reads real data.
A seller's own listings, newest first: my-listings, and her public profile.
Photos for one listing, in display order.

The daily contact cap: how many sellers this buyer has messaged since midnight. An equality filter and a range on a different field always needs a composite index. Without it, every tap on Message seller fails.
